Question.title: How do I use Go modules?

summary: Apache Answer is a Q&A platform (Go + xORM/MySQL). Registered users ask questions, post answers/comments, vote and follow, collect bookmarks, earn badges, report and review content, edit via review-queued revisions, and converse with an AI assistant; admins manage users/roles/site settings/API keys. Persisted state across 30 entities (user, question, answer, comment, tag, revision, activity, notification, report, review, meta, badge, collection, site info, config, ai_conversation, api_key, ...).

admin route group behind AdminAuth; no additional persisted pre-check or trigger beyond the route guard (internal/base/server/http.go:104)
internal notification queue worker (internal entry) that inserts Notification rows; not dispatched from a caller within our captured ops, no wall
scheduled hot-score recomputation cron (RefreshHottestCron); entry job/internal, system-triggered, no caller wall (internal/service/content/question_hottest_service.go)
scheduled maintenance cron that deletes orphan file records; entry job/internal, system-triggered, no caller wall (internal/service/file_record/file_record_service.go)
